explanation: Claims bounded sets in ℝ⁴ admit 8 parts of smaller diameter, tagged `research solved` on the basis of Tolmachev–Voronov (arXiv 2605.19068). The docstring itself says this is an unrefereed preprint with floating-point (not exact) computer verification. Labelling it solved overstates its status; `research open`, or a clear caveat in the category, would be more accurate. The formal statement itself is fine.
